title: Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation
summary: Claude Code Projects now features multi-threaded workspaces where a coordinator orchestrates parallel work across independent threads. Added shared memory accumulates project context and decisions, with a library for files and artifacts. In beta for Claude Pro/Max subscribers using cloud sessions; Team/Enterprise rollout planned next.

title: How to prepare for AI-driven code modernization projects
summary: Anthropic's forward-deployed engineers provide a 6-step framework for organizing AI-driven code modernization in critical and regulated systems. Introduces 'certificates' (conditions every change must meet) and 'promotion policies' (review depth based on risk), with recommendations for dedicated environments, CI/CD readiness, and pilot testing.

title: Working at the frontier: How Balyasny Asset Management evaluates and governs Claude Fable 5
summary: Balyasny Asset Management (~$38B AUM) shifted from AI-assisted search to autonomous agents via 'BAMAgent,' reducing merger analysis from 3-5 days to under one hour. Claude Fable 5 scored 89.4% on BAM's internal evaluation suite, with governance emphasizing data boundaries and tool permissions over model capability alone.

title: Claude Marketplace: one place to discover plugins, agents, and services from our partners
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Marketplace, a centralized hub combining 2,000+ connectors and plugins (Atlassian, Google, Salesforce), Claude-powered agents and products (CrowdStrike, Cursor), and consulting partners (Accenture, Deloitte). Partners can list via MCP connectors, Claude-powered products, or the Partner Network, with procurement simplified through committed spend consolidation.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: A case study shows how customers leverage Claude Marketplace to apply Anthropic spend commitments to partner services: Power Digital expanded Snowflake capacity, ThoughtSpot applied inference API purchases, and CodeRabbit upgraded to committed Vercel billing. This consolidates procurement across integrated tools into a single budget.

title: Build plugins for Claude
summary: Anthropic launched a new directory submission portal for developers on paid Claude plans to build and publish plugins. Developers can submit individual MCP connectors or bundled plugin packages with auto-validation, safety scanning, real-time review tracking, and usage analytics. The portal supports MCP 2.0 with extensions like MCP Apps for interactive UI and Enterprise Managed Auth for OAuth.
